mapper.sql: id, owner_user_id, title, content_object_key, persisted_log_id, last_modify_time, last_modify_user_id, deleted, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_document (owner_user_id, title, content_object_key, persisted_log_id, last_modify_time, last_modify_user_id, deleted, version) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{title}, #{contentObjectKey}, #{persistedLogId}, #{lastModifyTime}, #{lastModifyUserId}, #{deleted}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_document WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM biz_document WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY last_modify_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT d.id, d.owner_user_id, d.title, d.content_object_key, d.persisted_log_id, d.last_modify_time, d.last_modify_user_id, d.deleted, d.version, d.create_time, d.update_time FROM biz_document d LEFT JOIN biz_document_user du ON du.document_id = d.id AND du.user_id = #{userId} AND du.enabled = 1 AND du.permission IN ('READ', 'WRITE') WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND ( d.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR du.document_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY d.last_modify_time DESC, d.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_document SET last_modify_time = #{lastModifyTime}, last_modify_user_id = #{lastModifyUserId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND ( owner_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_document_user WHERE document_id = biz_document.id AND user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = 1 AND permission = 'WRITE' ) )

UPDATE biz_document SET title = #{title}, last_modify_time = #{lastModifyTime}, last_modify_user_id = #{lastModifyUserId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE biz_document SET content_object_key = #{contentObjectKey}, persisted_log_id = #{persistedLogId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND persisted_log_id = #{expectedPersistedLogId} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE biz_document SET deleted = 1, last_modify_time = #{lastModifyTime}, last_modify_user_id = #{lastModifyUserId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted = 0
